newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria discusses venture with General Chemical. [CORRECTED 16:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria discusses venture with General Chemical. [CORRECTED 16:45 GMT]

text.p: U.S. General Chemical Group Inc, which is in talks to buy a 60 percent stake in Bulgaria's Sodi Devnya plant, is negotiating setting up a joint venture to use an adjacent power plant and quarries, Industry Minister (corrects title from Economy Minister) Lyubomir Dachev said on Thursday.

Dachev said the Bulgarian government began negotiations on Wednesday on the joint venture, which would cover state-owned salt and limestone quarries and a thermal power plant not included in the privatisation.
Dachev told reporters General Chemical wanted majority participation in the joint venture's board.
Sodi Devnya exports 10 to 12 percent of the calcinated soda traded in the world.
Sodi Devnya, which can process 1.2 million tonnes of calcinated soda annually, currently operates at 80 percent of capacity and its net profit for last year was $3.5 million.
Its export markets include the Far East, the Middle East, Latin America and western Europe.
